landmarks.name: IceWing Palace
landmarks.blurb: Queen Snowfall’s seat in the far north, home of the gift of light.

landmarks.name: SandWing Stronghold
landmarks.blurb: Queen Thorn’s palace — built for defence, not beauty.

landmarks.name: SkyWing Palace
landmarks.blurb: Queen Ruby’s palace high in the northern mountains.

landmarks.name: MudWing Palace
landmarks.blurb: Queen Moorhen’s palace on the shore of her lake, south of the delta.

landmarks.name: Ruins of the Summer Palace
landmarks.blurb: Canopy-hidden SeaWing pavilion on a Bay island; burned by Burn’s army in the war.

landmarks.name: Deep Palace
landmarks.blurb: Queen Coral’s underwater capital, built of coral in a canyon.

landmarks.name: Island Palace
landmarks.blurb: Above-water SeaWing palace for guests and parties; long abandoned.

landmarks.name: RainWing Royal Pavilion
landmarks.blurb: Queen Glory’s court, halfway between the Rain and Night villages.

landmarks.name: Scorpion Den
landmarks.blurb: Sprawling walled city of criminals and hybrids; former Outclaws base.

landmarks.name: Vulture’s Compound
landmarks.blurb: Mine-and-trap-lined fortress of the Talons of Power, inside the Den.

landmarks.name: Possibility
landmarks.blurb: All-tribes town straddling the Great Five-Tail River — SandWing west bank, SkyWing east.

landmarks.name: Northern SkyWing Outpost
landmarks.blurb: Cliff-top guardhouse watching the northern sea for IceWings; Morrowseer’s test in The Dark Secret.

landmarks.name: Sanctuary
landmarks.blurb: Talons of Peace town in the Claws of the Clouds foothills.

landmarks.name: Jade Mountain Academy
landmarks.blurb: Intertribal school founded by the dragonets of destiny.

landmarks.name: RainWing Village
landmarks.blurb: Canopy village of hammocks and sun-time platforms.

landmarks.name: NightWing Village
landmarks.blurb: The tribe’s home after the Exodus, beside the RainWing village.

landmarks.name: RainWing Wingery
landmarks.blurb: Fortified play area for Rain and Night dragonets.

landmarks.name: Healer’s Pavilion
landmarks.blurb: RainWing healing hut in the rainforest canopy.

landmarks.name: Renewal
landmarks.blurb: Fierceteeth’s encampment of twenty-seven NightWings among the old ruins.

landmarks.name: Among-the-Evergreens
landmarks.blurb: IceWing village in the boreal forest.

landmarks.name: Hamlet-That-Worships-the-Whales-Who-Sing-at-Night
landmarks.blurb: IceWing coastal hamlet with the longest name in Pyrrhia.

landmarks.name: Where-the-Terns-Fly
landmarks.blurb: IceWing village on the western ice shelf.

landmarks.name: Where-the-Whales-Leap-at-Dawn
landmarks.blurb: IceWing village on the eastern coast of the head.

landmarks.name: Village-of-the-Plentiful-Seals
landmarks.blurb: IceWing sealing village on the northern shore.

landmarks.name: We-Remember-and-Venerate-Caribou
landmarks.blurb: IceWing village of the inland tundra herds.

landmarks.name: Where-No-Dragon-Goes-Hungry
landmarks.blurb: IceWing village near the southern fishing grounds.

landmarks.name: Jerboa III’s Hut
landmarks.blurb: Palm-frond hut in a quiet cove on the north-west desert coast.

landmarks.name: Prickle’s Hut
landmarks.blurb: Burned-down hut beside a five-palm pool in the desert.

landmarks.name: Blaze’s Fortress
landmarks.blurb: War-era SandWing fortress near the Ice Kingdom border.

landmarks.name: Blister’s Hideout
landmarks.blurb: Blister’s hidden war camp among the Bay islands.

landmarks.name: Indestructible City
landmarks.blurb: Cliff-top city of the Invincible Lord. Dragon maps mark it only as the largest scavenger den in Pyrrhia.

landmarks.name: Talisman
landmarks.blurb: Small town of the dragonmancers, south of the SkyWing palace.

landmarks.name: Valor
landmarks.blurb: Underground human city of tunnels below the southern Claws of the Clouds.

landmarks.name: Ruins of Valor
landmarks.blurb: The burned surface town on the Sand–Jade Mountain border; dragons call it the scavenger ruins.

landmarks.name: Safe Harbor
landmarks.blurb: Walled human town on the east coast, nearly the size of the Indestructible City. Blister burned it.

landmarks.name: Cottonmouth’s Empire
landmarks.blurb: Pre-Scorching human empire of pine slopes and mountain villages.

landmarks.name: Diamond Empire
landmarks.blurb: Cold pre-Scorching empire north of Cottonmouth’s, behind the range.

landmarks.name: Jaguar Empire
landmarks.blurb: Pre-Scorching empire of bays, islands and rock pools.

landmarks.name: Jade Mountain
landmarks.blurb: Twin fang-shaped peaks; tallest mountain in modern Pyrrhia.

landmarks.name: Agate Mountain
landmarks.blurb: Once the tallest peak; collapsed ~2,000 years ago over Darkstalker’s cave.

landmarks.name: Claws of the Clouds Mountains
landmarks.blurb: The spine of the continent, running north-east through the Sky Kingdom.

landmarks.name: Darkstalker’s Teeth
landmarks.blurb: Sharp-edged range walling the lost city off from the Kingdom of Sand.

landmarks.name: Borderland Mountain
landmarks.blurb: Peak in the lower reaches of the old NightWing palace.

landmarks.name: NightWing Volcano
landmarks.blurb: The tribe’s abandoned island fortress above the lava, a day’s flight north of the Sky Kingdom.

landmarks.name: Under the Mountain
landmarks.blurb: The cave where the dragonets of destiny were raised for six years.

landmarks.name: Great Ice Cliff
landmarks.blurb: Animus-carved wall along the Ice–Sand border.

landmarks.name: Disputed Tundra
landmarks.blurb: Barren wasteland contested by IceWings and SandWings.

landmarks.name: Great Five-Tail River
landmarks.blurb: The most disputed ground in Pyrrhia — SandWings west bank, SkyWings east, Possibility in the middle.

landmarks.name: Diamond Spray River
landmarks.blurb: Second-longest river; runs from the SkyWing palace to the sea.

landmarks.name: Diamond Spray Delta
landmarks.blurb: Where the lowest-born MudWings live, on the east coast.

landmarks.name: Winding Tail River
landmarks.blurb: Silver river down the east flank of the Claws of the Clouds, past Jade Mountain to the sea.

landmarks.name: Queen Moorhen’s Lake
landmarks.blurb: The great lake of the Mud Kingdom, with the MudWing palace on its shore.

landmarks.name: Talon Peninsula
landmarks.blurb: Clawed spit south-west of the desert; what is left of the old Night Kingdom.

landmarks.name: Bay of a Thousand Scales
landmarks.blurb: Spiral archipelago of hundreds of islands — the dragon’s tail.

landmarks.name: North Beach
landmarks.blurb: Boulder-strewn beach at the peninsula’s north end, facing the Kingdom of Sand across the bay.

landmarks.name: Lost City of Night
landmarks.blurb: Ruined NightWing capital of canyons and carved caverns, half sunk into the sea.

landmarks.name: The Great Diamond
landmarks.blurb: Diamond formed by the tribe’s four great buildings.

landmarks.name: NightWing Palace
landmarks.blurb: Queen Vigilance’s towered palace, built into the mountain.

landmarks.name: NightWing School
landmarks.blurb: Northern point of the Great Diamond; abandoned at the Exodus.

landmarks.name: NightWing Library
landmarks.blurb: Southern point of the Diamond; Clearsight kept a study here.

landmarks.name: NightWing Museum
landmarks.blurb: Fourth of the great buildings of the Diamond.

landmarks.name: Darkstalker’s Home
landmarks.blurb: House of Arctic, Foeslayer, Whiteout and Darkstalker.

landmarks.name: Clearsight’s Home
landmarks.blurb: Home of Clearsight and Swiftwings in the old city.

landmarks.name: Harmony
landmarks.blurb: Ancient hybrid refuge in the forests between the Beetle and Leaf Kingdoms.

landmarks.name: Beetle Kingdom
landmarks.blurb: Abandoned BeetleWing territory, split between Sky and Rain.

landmarks.name: Leaf Kingdom
landmarks.blurb: Abandoned LeafWing territory before the flight to Pantala.
